title: Human Loop Correction Schema
description: Manual correction/review results. User makes CONFIRM, ASSIGN (new student), or REJECT decision.

original_student_id.description: Student ID from auto-detection (may be null)

corrected_student_id.description: Corrected student ID (for CONFIRM/ASSIGN). null for REJECT.

action.description: CONFIRM: auto was correct | ASSIGN: corrected to new student | REJECT: invalid event

operator_id.description: User ID of the operator performing correction

confidence_override.description: Optional manual confidence adjustment by operator

review_duration_seconds.description: Time operator took to review (for metrics)
